discipline_just_cause_001.evidence: Employees covered by this agreement may be disciplined for just cause in the following ways: 1. Informal contact (site record)... 2. Verbal warning... 3. Written Reprimand... 4. Suspension With/Without Pay... 5. Termination

discipline_dismissal_002.evidence: In those situations where the progressive disciplinary steps have not resulted in modification of the identified behavior, or where the employee commits a serious infraction, the employee may be terminated from employment. A termination must be made by recommendation of the Superintendent to the Board.
